description.narrative: The project is designed to realize the full production potential of large-scale irrigation schemes in Bangladesh. It will address the recurrent lack of sustainable management, operation, and maintenance (MOM) and increase water productivity by transferring MOM schemes to private operators and introducing innovative infrastructure modernization. The project will focus on modernizing the Muhuri Irrigation Project (MIP) in Chittagong division. It will also finance a feasibility study and detailed design for modernizing the Ganges-Kobadak Irrigation Project in Khulna division and the Teesta Irrigation Project in Rangpur division.

Output: Irrigation management and agriculture support services improved Indicator: Long-term performance-based lease contract signed for Muhuri Irrigation Project large-scale irrigation project. Achievement: Y Progress/Status: Achieved. Based on assessment of performance of the construction phase-irrigation management operator (C-IMO), public-private partnership (PPP) long term lease contractor was not recommended by the Independent Panel of Experts (IPOE), engaged by ADB. IPOE reviewed the existing system and recommended establishing a M-IMO Board instead for long-term irrigation management system for Muhuri Irrigation Project. BWDB prepared the guideline for M-IMO constitution which was not convergence with IPOE's proposal. Based on BWDB's proposal, which was agreed by ADB, a leasing framework guideline has been prepared by BWDB to leasing out the schemes to WMOs gradually. The guideline was approved by MOWR by September 2024. The first batch schemes (112 nos.) are signed on 31-Dec-2024. To date, a total of 130 schemes have been leased out.
